user.title: Set up 9292 public transport
user.description: Choose how often to refresh. You add routes afterwards via Configure.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one instance of 9292 OV is allowed.

route.title: Route
route.description: Name the route and choose its travel options. In the next steps you search for the start and the end.

data.name: Name
data.less_walking: Less walking at start and end

data_description.person: Optional. Links the route to a person: it shows in the device name and as the `person` attribute of its sensors, so you can filter and automate per person.

from_search.title: Start of the route
from_search.description: Where does “{name}” start? Search for a place, station, stop or address. Current: {current}

data_description.query: Type at least a few letters. Leave empty to keep the current place (when editing).

from_pick.title: Choose the start
from_pick.description: Pick the right place for the start of “{name}”.

to_search.title: End of the route
to_search.description: Where does “{name}” end? Search for a place, station, stop or address. Current: {current}

data_description.query: Type at least a few letters. Leave empty to keep the current place (when editing).

to_pick.title: Choose the end
to_pick.description: Pick the right place for the end of “{name}”.

timing.title: When to travel
timing.description: Fixed time or from an entity. With an entity, the time of that entity is used (a time, a date and time, a timestamp sensor or the start of a calendar event) and the fixed time below is ignored. The offset moves the time: -10 means 10 minutes earlier.

data_description.time_entity: Input date/time, time, timestamp sensor or calendar. Leave empty to use the fixed time.
data_description.weekdays: Only used with a fixed time: the route plans for the next of these days.

error.no_results: Nothing found. Try another search, for example a station name or a street and place.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach 9292. Try again in a moment.

options.now: Now (live): the next journeys from this moment
